title: dekc --json
description: What each dek command prints with --json, one JSON object per line. $defs holds one schema per command, and `failure` for a command line that could not run. While dek is 0.x the shape may change between releases.

updated.description: dek's own files, already there, brought up to date.

kept.description: Files already there that differ from what init would write.

playwright.description: How to install Playwright, when it is missing.

from.description: The rev it was pinned to before, when this moved it.

script.description: The section as script.md has it, beat headings and their ids included.

beats.description: The section's beats in order: what a data-step names, by id or by position.

theme.description: The rules of the deck's theme.css this slide uses: those its classes, layout, elements, and attributes match; with a slide script, every element and attribute rule under .slide.

classes.description: The classes slide markup may use; what max_classes counts.

stateClasses.description: State classes the theme selects that the player sets at runtime (is-current, is-shown); never written in markup.

fill.description: How much of the frame the slide fills: each text's lines, each picture's box, and each painted box that holds nothing, as a chart's bar; a card counts by what it holds; decoration under aria-hidden counts too, ::before and ::after text does not. Judge a slide by rows, columns, and box, not coverage alone. Shares from 0 to 1. Absent when the slide was not measured.

step.description: The beat measured: the last, as the slide's shot shows it.

coverage.description: The share of the frame the content covers.

box.description: The smallest box holding it, as shares of the frame. Absent when there is none.

rows.description: The share of each tenth of the frame, top to bottom.

fill.description: How much of the frame the slide fills: each text's lines, each picture's box, and each painted box that holds nothing, as a chart's bar; a card counts by what it holds; decoration under aria-hidden counts too, ::before and ::after text does not. Judge a slide by rows, columns, and box, not coverage alone. Shares from 0 to 1. Absent when the slide was not measured.

step.description: The beat measured: the last, as the slide's shot shows it.

coverage.description: The share of the frame the content covers.

box.description: The smallest box holding it, as shares of the frame. Absent when there is none.

rows.description: The share of each tenth of the frame, top to bottom.

to.description: A morph frame: the slide the transition goes to.

at.description: A morph frame: where in the transition, 0..1.

shots.description: Each still or morph frame; with --motion, empty: the frames are in motion.

motion.description: With --motion, each beat in order with its frames, the settled end last.

viewers.description: The pages that show the deck; with none, where the next one opened lands.
The pages that show the deck; with none, where the next one opened lands.

beat.description: The beat's title; null for what the slide says before its first ###.

beatIndex.description: Null once the beat is gone.

status.description: edited once the words differ from what was marked; gone with the beat.

was.description: The beat's words when it was marked.

number.description: As the dev page's markers and Copy number it.

step.description: The stop as `dekc shot --step` takes it; 0 as the slide arrives.

status.description: edited once the slide's own html, css, or ts changed since the note; gone once none of its elements is on the slide.

line.description: Where the start tag is now; where it was last found when not found.

column.description: 1-based, in UTF-16 units as editors count.

name.description: The tag and its classes as written where it was last found, as div.chevron.

was.description: Its text as written when the note was written, cut short.

text.description: Its text as written now; null when not found.

box.description: On the slide in logical pixels, when the note was written.

point.description: Where the slide itself was clicked.

changed.description: The slide's own files that changed since the note.

shot.description: The command that shows the slide at the note's beat.

images.description: dist/<deck>.png for each deck that got a link preview image.

hint.description: The next step, whenever dek knows it.

id.description: DEKnnn for dek's own rules; another tool's id for its findings.

severity.description: Only an error fails lint and check.

column.description: 1-based, in UTF-16 units as editors count.

slug.description: The slide the finding is about.

hint.description: The fix, phrased as what to do next.

data.description: The values the message names, as fields.

hint.description: What to do so that the check runs.

SkippedCheck.description: A check that did not run, so an empty list of findings is no pass for it.

RefInfo.description: Set when the deck read is a ref.
